nodes.text: Focus only on countries located in Europe.

To get the list of European countries with manufacturing industries, you can modify the previous query as follows: SELECT c.country_name FROM countries c INNER JOIN industries i ON c.country_id = i.country_id WHERE i.industry_type = 'Manufacturing' AND c.continent = 'Europe'
Identify countries that have a minimum of 3 manufacturers.

To get the list of European countries that have a minimum of 3 manufacturing industries, you can use the following SQL query: SELECT c.country_name, COUNT(i.industry_type) AS num_manufacturers FROM countries c INNER JOIN industries i ON c.country_id = i.country_id WHERE i.industry_type = 'Manufacturing' AND c.continent = 'Europe' GROUP BY c.country_name HAVING COUNT(i.industry_type) >= 3
Specifically look for car manufacturers in those countries.

To get the list of European countries that have a minimum of 3 car manufacturing industries, you can use the following SQL query: SELECT c.country_name, COUNT(i.industry_type) AS num_car_manufacturers FROM countries c INNER JOIN industries i ON c.country_id = i.country_id WHERE i.industry_type = 'Car Manufacturing' AND c.continent = 'Europe' GROUP BY c.country_name HAVING COUNT(i.industry_type) >= 3
